notice: Complete candidate catalogue derived from GPT’s agreed source profiles. The transport procedure chapter, integrated worked records and exact candidate review remain ahead.

profiles.name: Camel
profiles.operationalStatus: NEW SOURCE-AUTHORING PROFILE; exact candidate not yet approved

operational.provenance: All size, mass, abilities, natural AC, HP/Hit Dice, senses, behavior, supply quantities, draw capability and reference level below are NEW provisional game values, not inferred anatomy/Strength or external bestiary statistics. Source purchase price, walking Speed and carry pounds alone are retained numbers.

hitDice.restUse: real remaining dice and ordinary creature rest/healing limits; fixed maximumHP is this NEW profile, not regenerated from a class table

operational.saves: ability modifier only unless an actual later source grants proficiency; current Wounds/conditions apply
operational.initiative: DEX modifier plus actual lawful modifiers
operational.senses: ordinary sight, hearing and smell subject to actual light, line, distance/noise; no darkvision, blindsight, special detection or automatic advantage
operational.cargoLoadProvenance: NEW explicit profile Load cap independent of Strength; not claimed source value
operational.burdenedAtLoadOrPounds: positive supported load at least half the respective limit; one Burdened speed penalty, not two for the same state
operational.hardCarryAdmission: must meet both pounds/Load and physical fit; no routine movement above either full cap
operational.riderSizeRule: at least one size smaller; saddle and actual body compatible; both personal gear and rider equipment count
operational.drawLimitProvenance: NEW separate trained-harness capability on firm rolling surface or appropriate ice/snow runners; never a five-times Strength inference
operational.drawMovement: minimum actual puller speed and vehicle cap; a gross draw above half the combined draw rating also causes the one Burdened speed penalty. Loads on a puller and towing constraints are separately checked; the same named penalty is not doubled. No slopes, broken axles or impassable terrain waived.

attack.name: Kick
attack.activation: Action on its own independent regular turn only; one attack
attack.critical: Core natural20 doubles damage dice only; natural1 misses

operational.otherActions: independent actual creature may use physically compatible Core Actions; controlled ridden Action list is Dash, Disengage, Dodge only; no Multiattack or automatic opportunity attack while controlled
operational.deathRule: NEW default registered Expedition mount is significant and uses ordinary Core Wounds/dying/death saves. Mark significance before an encounter; no retrospective designation to dodge death. A later actual Ranger Beast bond uses its expressly different HP-only/immediate-death lifecycle instead.
operational.training: Actual ride/cargo/harness/armor training recorded separately under TR-02/07. Purchase name/price is not proof of present training, willingness or health. War-named template may be sold with documented combat habituation but gains no new controlled attack.

dailyFeed.meaning: NEW one animal-day sold feed quantity for this template at the printed5cp daily reference. Actual species-compatible stock must be supplied; no fodder-to-meat conversion or infinite vendor stock.

operational.foodCare: Use these NEW animal quantities instead of the human Small/Medium/Large Supply basket, with actual safe water and continued rest. Do not add human lamp oil demand to an animal. Unmet daily food/water gives at most1 ordinary expedition Strain for that day; no additional duplicate failure per missing component. No automatic desert-fasting trait.
operational.threatReferenceProvenance: NEW encounter-budget comparison only, not a CR, character class level, Ranger acquisition authorization or XP award
operational.sourceCR: absent; retain absence, and any actual CR-gated ability needs its genuine source/profile predicate rather than treating referenceLevel as CR
operational.custody: actual individual creature ID and original body history; Donkey or mule is one selected individual, not two. Purchase, hire, boarding, battle loss, rescue, bond and sale preserve that history.

operational.provenance: Price retained; EVERY mass,HP,geometry,draft,crew,seat,cargo,propulsion and Speed number is explicitly NEW provisional game-profile authorship. No outside vessel stat block, inherent weapons, crew or cargo imported.
operational.inventoryIncluded: actual hull, principal mast/sail/rigging where sail mode exists, oars/rowlocks for stated oar mode, ordinary rudder/tiller and mooring lines. No crew, food/water, personal gear, cargo, weapons, lifeboat, magic or elemental power.
operational.crewGate: one designated trained Vehicles(Water) helmsman for hazardous navigation; actual capable crew meet each mode minimum and work continuously. Calm ordinary paddling/rowing may be physically attempted untrained without automatic penalty; uncertainty uses TR-09 actual check. Source-specific proficiency gates override.
operational.movementEvent: one vessel drive event per numbered round after a current helm Action and all required actual crew contributions for that mode are available. One person may satisfy rowboat helm+oar in one combined Action, otherwise each required crew member is distinct. Resolve after the last necessary contributing turn/Action, rechecking current feasibility. Contributions cannot also make attacks/Help/guard/beneficial rest. Extra Actions/extra turns or a new helm do not make a second event. No native vessel turn,Reaction,Dash,Disengage or attack.
operational.travel: actual continuous staffed labor on FL-03 clock; speed is one active hour basis, not miles per second. Crew shifts need real people, food and rest. Passengers can perform compatible limited activity only if real movement/environment permits; no automatic rest or full workshop.
operational.currentWind: actual route must supply water-current vector and sail feasibility. No stated current defaults to0 in the synthetic model only, not proof of calm seas. Sail calm or directly unsupported wind course gives0 self-propulsion; oars can still work if supplied. Ordinary usable wind gives stated sail speed; declared adverse-but-usable conditions halve it. Stronger weather needs actual hazard stakes, not an automatic new storm. Tactical actual current displacement is separate from own propulsion; countercurrent subtracts along route, minimum0 ground progress, with actual drift retained.
operational.turning: clear swept envelope required; a90-degree heading change requires at least one hull-length traveled and sufficient water/clearance, or an actual stationary line/anchor maneuver taking10 active minutes with working crew. No instant spin through walls.
operational.docking: actual slow approach, available berth/bank, water depth, lines and capable receiver/crew. Uncontested calm docking needs no roll; hazardous approach uses declared Vehicles(Water) DC and failure under TR-09. Load/unload is extra real handling. Mast lowering is not free; separate actually feasible20-minute crew operation, mast/clearance accounted during it.
operational.primaryConstituents: original principal keel/hull frame and steering body; original primary mast/rig where needed to restore that same sail assembly. Compatible planking, cloth sails, ropes, oars and subordinate fittings may be replaced with actual stock, not invented from a cost quotation.
operational.zeroHP: Broken and propulsion disabled. If afloat and no specific different destruction source governs, NEW begins one10-minute flooding/evacuation deadline; at it the wreck becomes submerged/stranded according to actual depth/bank/support, not deleted. Occupants receive actual fall/swim/drowning/escape procedures, not automatic death or shared hull damage. Repairing, touching or renaming the hull cannot reset that event.
operational.emergencyShoring: NEW once per actual hull-breaking damage episode: two capable workers, at least one trained Carpenter tools or Vehicles(Water), real compatible patch/bracing material priced at1%undamaged body reference (minimum1gp),five uninterrupted active minutes before the flooding deadline; DC15 appropriate tool task,Core collapsed binary. Success keeps that same disabled hull afloat for60 minutes from completion, withoutHP,propulsion or a new seaworthy status; failure spends work/materials and does not alter deadline. It cannot be repeated on that same rupture to bank time. Grounding/towing to genuine support may permit later full repair.
operational.repair: TR-14 actual structural repair, full required original body, trained suitable toolkit, dry/supportable worksite; generic25%body material reference/DC10/max(1h,maxHP/10h) unless a specific actual repair authority differs. Core complete service quote10%/15% is an alternative, not another material charge. No repair while the purported workpiece is irretrievably absent.
